senses.gloss: m. pl. (v. אֲשַׁר Pa.) sale on trust, debts for goods sold.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 113a:9">Pes. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>כל א׳ וכ׳</he> in all sales on trust it is doubtful, whether it (the money) will be forthcoming or not, and if it is, it is bad money, (partial payment, bad coins &c).—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 63b:5">B. Mets. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>אית ליה א׳ וכ׳</he> he has debts to collect.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 22a:5">B. Bath. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>אית לן א׳ וכ׳</he> we have outstanding debts to collect (and we must stay until we have collected them).
